items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Wendell Culley was there. He was playing lead... So that’s one of the reasons I was hired.

ctx.x: That’s funny. How did you get with this band? How did you start playing with Noble Sissle’s band?

Somebody in the band recommended me, because they had a lot of things where they needed – a lot of technical playing. They had – Wendell Culley was there. He was playing lead, but he wasn’t always there, and also they needed somebody who could play – do the triple-tonguing, double-tonguing when it was needed, with him. So that’s one of the reasons I was hired. I stayed there for a while. To his credit, Noble Sissle, who was also one of these people who was very aware of the black progress and so forth – I got…
Was that the first time you played on Broadway?
